title: Variables Basics
description: Help students use variables to store and reuse values.
learning_goals: Store input in a named variable
Reuse the same variable in output
hint_ladder: Pick a clear variable name for the input value.
After assignment, reuse the same variable when printing.
Example flow: read input into `name`, then print a greeting with that variable.

common_mistakes.pattern: Reads input but never stores it
common_mistakes.diagnosis: The value cannot be reused without a variable.
common_mistakes.hint: Assign the result of input to one variable before printing.

common_mistakes.pattern: Uses a different variable name when printing
common_mistakes.diagnosis: Printing another name causes a NameError or wrong value.
common_mistakes.hint: Use the same variable consistently in assignment and output.

refusal_rules: Do not output a full final answer code block.
Keep explanations inside beginner-level variable concepts.
